data.name: 视讯判官：水军指挥官
data.detailed_description:
A satirical simulation game set against the backdrop of contemporary social media ecology. In this game, you will play the role of a "paid comment syndicate leader," manipulating public opinion trends on short video platforms to complete various PR tasks, guide public emotions, and even influence the direction of social hot topics.

The game simulates a highly realistic short video feed interface—you can browse various short video content just like using a real mobile app by swiping up and down: from celebrity gossip and social news to political controversies and online rumors, everything is available. Each video comes with interactive data such as comment sections, like counts, and share volumes, and your task is to influence these metrics through precise operations.

You can:

  • Mass like or downvote specific videos to artificially boost or suppress their popularity;

  • Post paid comments to set the narrative, stir emotions, create opposition, or whitewash controversial figures;

  • Trigger hidden storylines: when opinion manipulation reaches a critical point, rare events may occur—such as trending topic explosions, public shaming of individuals, or brand crisis reversals;

  • Deal with platform review mechanisms: excessive manipulation may trigger anti-cheat systems, resulting in account bans or mission failures, requiring careful balance of operational scale.

As you progress through levels, you will face increasingly complex public opinion battlefields... Every swipe could potentially change the perceptions of millions.

data.short_description: Just released from prison, former top-tier celebrity Fanfan becomes your first major assignment. As the paid comment syndicate leader, you take on this mission and gradually grow into the underground PR master handling various social public opinion incidents!
